## Hi, I’m Martinas 

Welcome to my ePortfolio.

I’m in my final year of Business Studies International at DCU, specialising in Data Analytics with Japanese as my language. Most of what I’ve worked on during the degree has sat somewhere between business, data and language, and this portfolio is where I’ve put it all in one place.

You’ll find a mix of things here: data projects, written assignments, presentations, and a few reflections on how my thinking has changed along the way. Some of it is technical, some of it isn’t, but it all says something about what I’ve been learning.

## {{< fa regular folder >}} What’s in the Portfolio 

This is a snapshot of where I am now and the kind of work I want to keep doing. The areas it covers are:

- Academic assignments from various modules taken during the four year degree.
- My hobbies and interests
- Tools that I've used throughout my studies (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Python, R, Excel)
- Certifications and courses I have completed 

## {{< fa regular compass >}} Have a Look Around

Feel free to click through whatever interests you. Each project has a bit of context about what it was, what I did, and what I took from it.
